_doc: Racing kerbs traced off the aerial for the Lake Murray engine port (ledger 0078). Each run is the lane edge it lies along, as lon/lat, plus where its paint sits across that edge (in_m / out_m: metres past the lane edge of the live line's widths, - = inside). The build places the kerb OUTSIDE the lane edge (tools/author_kerbs_blend.py); its profile is the track config's kerb, NOT measured (a 1 m DEM cannot read a kerb).
imagery: USDA NAIP m_3910641_se_13_060_20190914 (2019-09-14, 0.6 m), USGS NAIP ImageServer exportImage in EPSG:4326 with square-degree pixels (the box held exactly; corners W,N,E,S -106.88306156,39.26820288,-106.87823919,39.26223671)
method: tools/aerial_edges.py colour reader first (2 runs: one the kerb at s 1025, one a blue car at s 225, rejected); every run then read by eye off 6x zooms with the live line's edges and 5 m station ticks drawn; in_m / out_m [invented]: the blocks straddle the edge, about 1.5 m wide. Not seen: kerbs at the top hairpin's exit and the south-east hairpin (white edge marks only, no blocks).
line: data/gate_centerline.json of the live track (engine frame)

kerbs.how: eye, station-labelled 6x zooms of the NAIP (the right-hander after the pit-out bend: white and faded-red blocks on the left edge)
eye, station-labelled 6x zooms of the NAIP (the west leg into the U: white / red blocks on the right edge)
eye, station-labelled 6x zooms of the NAIP (the south-west hairpin's entry: red and white blocks on the outside (left) edge)

runoff.note: No paved run-off: the reader's 'asphalt' runs past the edge are the access road, the pit apron and the infield dirt tracks where they meet the lap; none is a run-off area.

not_built.how: eye, station-labelled 6x zooms of the NAIP (the run up to the top hairpin: white blocks (the red reads faded) on the left edge)
not_built.not_built_why: ledger 0081 round 2, Kevin 2026-11-05 ("I just want real"): read off NAIP 2019 (0.6 m); NAIP 2023 (0.3 m) shows a plain light edge band here, no blocks (kerbs_2023_030_check.jpg). The newest imagery is what is there, so it is not built
